purpose: Canonical visual and information architecture for Portfolio student packets and teacher evidence summaries.

page_1: exact MG + I Can + Bank family practice path
page_2: all I Cans with current status

teacher_summary.latest_evidence_pages: 2x2 I Can card layout; combined course first, then one page per period when about four affected I Cans fit.
teacher_summary.longitudinal_page: Final combined Portfolio Evidence Sort page uses a 2x2 I Can card layout and the full evidence history, not only the latest assessment.
teacher_summary.name_format: Bulleted compact lists. Group periods under headers when needed. First name + last initial is acceptable.
teacher_summary.status_summary: Show current No Evidence / Developing / Mastered / Transfer counts, independent opportunity count, latest evidence source/date, and review flags for each displayed I Can.

bank_practice_link.stable_anchor_rule: Family anchor is the canonical family_id, e.g. U1-MG01-IC04-A. I Can and Mastery Goal anchors remain canonical IDs.
